question: A person is arrested for an offence punishable with life imprisonment. The investigation remains incomplete, and the accused has been in custody for 60 days. During this period, the Magistrate has repeatedly granted police custody in separate intervals, even though the accused was produced before the Magistrate only through video conferencing on some occasions. The prosecution has not filed the charge-sheet yet. The accused now seeks default bail, while the prosecution argues that police custody can still be granted within the statutory period and that the pendency of the investigation defeats the claim for bail. Analyze whether the accused is entitled to default bail under Section 187 of the BNSS, 2023, whether the Magistrate could authorize police custody in this manner, and what constitutional safeguards under Articles 21 and 22 are implicated.
